description: This file implements the SourceDir class and related functions for handling directory paths, including validation, resolution, and string manipulation within a build system context.

classes.name: SourceDir
classes.description: Represents a source directory path with methods for resolution and validation.

classes.name: SourceFile
classes.description: Represents a source file, used in path resolution.

methods.name: SourceDir::SourceDir
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SourceDir object with a string view.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeAs
methods.description: Resolves a relative path as a file or directory, with validation.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeFile
methods.description: Resolves a relative path to a SourceFile object.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeDir
methods.description: Resolves a relative path to a SourceDir object.

methods.name: SourceDir::Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the directory path relative to a source root.
